steps.title: Mock
steps.body: Glean mocked; your source clients unchanged. Does transform produce the right documents?

steps.title: Integration
steps.body: Real source, recorded and replayed; Glean still mocked. It rejects missing permissions, anonymous access, and all-datasource-users access, because they prevent proving denial.

steps.title: Prove denial
steps.body: Counting indexed documents proves nothing about permissions. The search result is the ground truth.
